It is laid out like the iPad's Settings app: a list of sections beside the open section on a wide screen, and the list, then the section, on a phone. It follows the conventions in #3728's `docs/polish/10-menus.md`. ### Where it stands `/account` (`routes/account.tsx`, `routes/account.css`) is one column: - email and status; - rank on both ladders, Constructed and All Random, with the crest, streak and badges; - a Leaderboard link; - the record: win rate, W–L–D and games played; - a "Manage sign-in & account" disclosure that holds the username, secret ID, email, two-step, linked accounts (Google #3025, Roblox #3507) and delete; - Sign out. It has no portrait and no match history, and its header notes that it "links no other menu". ### The screen ``` ┌───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ (portrait) Ana#1234 Copy Constructed ◆ Gold II │ │ Member since Oct 2026 All Random ◆ Silver I 🔥3 │ ├──────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────┤ │ ▶ Overview │ This season 41–30–2 57% │ │ Match history │ All time 120–98–5 54% │ │ Sign-in & security │ Badges … │ │ Notifications │ │ │ Privacy & data │ │ │ Delete account │ │ │ [ Sign out ] │ │ └──────────────────────┴────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` - **The profile header**: - the equipped hero portrait (an account cosmetic, #1827) and `name#tag` with Copy; - each ladder's crest and division, the season's record (#2255) and the win-streak flame (#2101); - when the account was made. - **Overview**: this season's and the all-time record, the badges, and the Leaderboard link. - **Match history**: recent games, each with its result, mode, opponent, date and Watch replay, linking into `/replays` (what it already lists). Sign out sits at the bottom of the list. - **Each section has its own URL** (`/account?section=…`), so Back and links land on it. ### Acceptance - Every field and action the screen has today is still reachable, in the section listed above.
